problems.title: Two Sum
problems.desc: Given N integers and a target integer T, find the 0-based indices of the two numbers such that they add up to T. Print the two indices separated by a space in increasing order.
problems.con: 2 <= N <= 10^4, -10^9 <= nums[i], T <= 10^9. Exactly one solution exists.

problems.title: Palindrome Number
problems.desc: Given an integer X, print true if X is a palindrome, and false otherwise.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.desc: Given a string S containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. Print true or false.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.desc: Read N (size of first list) followed by N sorted integers. Then read M (size of second list) followed by M sorted integers. Output the merged sorted sequence separated by spaces.

problems.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
problems.desc: Given N and a sorted integer array of size N, remove the duplicates in-place such that each unique element appears only once. Print K (number of unique elements) followed by the unique elements on the next line.

problems.title: Remove Element
problems.desc: Read N and val, followed by an integer array of size N. Remove all occurrences of val. Output the count of remaining elements K, followed by the remaining elements in their relative order.

problems.title: Search Insert Position
problems.desc: Given a sorted array of distinct integers and a target value, return the index if the target is found. If not, return the index where it would be if it were inserted in order.

problems.title: Plus One
problems.desc: You are given a large integer represented as an integer array of N digits. Increment the large integer by one and return the resulting array of digits separated by space.

problems.title: Add Binary
problems.desc: Given two binary strings a and b, print their sum as a binary string.

problems.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List
problems.desc: Given N and a sorted linked list of N numbers, delete all duplicates such that each element appears only once. Print the resulting sequence.

problems.title: Merge Sorted Array
problems.desc: Read m and n. Then read m integers of array nums1, followed by n integers of array nums2. Output nums1 and nums2 merged into a single sorted array.

problems.title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
problems.desc: Given an array of values representing a binary tree in level-order (where 'null' represents missing child), output its inorder traversal sequence separated by space.

problems.title: Same Tree
problems.desc: Given level-order strings for two binary trees p and q on separate lines, check if they are identical in structure and node values. Output true or false.

problems.title: Symmetric Tree
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, print true if it is a mirror of itself (symmetric around its center), and false otherwise.

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.desc: Given a binary tree's level-order string, print its maximum depth (number of nodes along the longest path from root to leaf).

problems.title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
problems.desc: Given N and a sorted array of N numbers, convert it into a height-balanced BST. Print the root node value followed by its maximum depth.

problems.title: Minimum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, find its minimum depth (the number of nodes along the shortest path from root to the nearest leaf).

problems.title: Path Sum
problems.desc: Read targetSum on line 1, followed by level-order representation of tree on line 2. Print true if the tree has a root-to-leaf path such that sum equals targetSum, else false.

problems.title: Pascal's Triangle II
problems.desc: Given an integer rowIndex (0-indexed), return the rowIndex-th row of the Pascal's triangle separated by space.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.desc: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward. Print true or false.
problems.si: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

problems.title: Single Number
problems.desc: Given N and an array of N numbers where every element appears twice except for one, find and output that single element.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.desc: Given N nodes and pos (0-indexed position where tail links back to, or -1 if no cycle), print true if there is a cycle, and false otherwise.

problems.title: Binary Tree Preorder Traversal
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, output its preorder traversal sequence separated by spaces.

problems.title: Binary Tree Postorder Traversal
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, output its postorder traversal sequence separated by spaces.

problems.title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
problems.desc: Given two lists, find the value of the node at which the two lists intersect. If they do not intersect, print 0.

problems.title: Majority Element
problems.desc: Given N and an array of N numbers, print the majority element that appears more than ⌊N / 2⌋ times.

problems.title: Number of 1 Bits
problems.desc: Given a positive integer N, return the number of set bits ('1's) it has (the Hamming weight).

problems.title: Remove Linked List Elements
problems.desc: Read N and val on line 1, followed by N integers on line 2. Remove all nodes of value val and print the remaining list, or 'empty' if list is empty.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.desc: Given N and an integer sequence of N numbers, reverse the list and print the numbers separated by spaces.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.desc: Given N and an array of N integers, print true if any value appears at least twice, and false if every element is distinct.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, invert the tree (swap left and right child at each node) and print the resulting level-order string.

problems.title: Summary Ranges
problems.desc: Given N and a sorted unique integer array, return the smallest sorted list of ranges that cover all numbers. Output ranges separated by space (e.g. 0->2 4->5 7).

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.desc: Given an integer n, print true if it is a power of two, otherwise false.

problems.title: Palindrome Linked List
problems.desc: Given N and a sequence of N numbers, print true if the sequence is a palindrome, else false.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.desc: Given two lowercase strings s and t on separate lines, print true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.

problems.title: Binary Tree Paths
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, return all root-to-leaf paths separated by space (formatted like 1->2->5).

problems.title: Add Digits
problems.desc: Given an integer num, repeatedly add all its digits until the result has only one digit, and print it.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.desc: Given N and an array containing N distinct numbers in the range [0, N], return the only number in the range that is missing from the array.

problems.title: Move Zeroes
problems.desc: Given N and an integer array, move all 0's to the end while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements. Print the resulting array.

problems.title: Word Pattern
problems.desc: Given a pattern string and a string s of space-separated words, print true if s follows the exact same pattern bijectively, and false otherwise.
problems.ht:
abba
dog cat cat fish
---
false
===
aaaa
dog cat cat dog
---
false

problems.title: Power of Three
problems.desc: Given an integer n, print true if it is a power of three, else false.

problems.title: Reverse String
problems.desc: Read a string S. Print the reversed string.

problems.title: Intersection of Two Arrays
problems.desc: Read N, then N integers for array 1; then M, then M integers for array 2. Output the unique intersection elements in sorted order separated by space.

problems.title: Guess Number Higher or Lower
problems.desc: Given n (range 1 to n) and pick (the picked secret number), find the secret number using binary search and print it.

problems.title: Ransom Note
problems.desc: Given two strings ransomNote and magazine on separate lines, print true if ransomNote can be constructed using letters from magazine, else false.
problems.ht:
aa
ab
---
false
===
aa
aab
---
true

problems.title: First Unique Character in a String
problems.desc: Given a string s, find the first non-repeating character in it and print its 0-based index. If it does not exist, print -1.

problems.title: Is Subsequence
problems.desc: Given two strings s and t on separate lines, print true if s is a subsequence of t, or false otherwise.

problems.title: Fizz Buzz
problems.desc: Given an integer n, print the 1-indexed string representation from 1 to n separated by space where multiples of 3 are 'Fizz', 5 are 'Buzz', and both are 'FizzBuzz'.
problems.ht:
3
---
1 2 Fizz
===
15
---
1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz Fizz 7 8 Fizz Buzz 11 Fizz 13 14 FizzBuzz

problems.title: Add Strings
problems.desc: Given two non-negative integers num1 and num2 represented as strings, return the sum of num1 and num2 as a string.

problems.title: Max Consecutive Ones
problems.desc: Given N and a binary array of N elements, return the maximum number of consecutive 1's in the array.

problems.title: Perfect Number
problems.desc: A perfect number is a positive integer that is equal to the sum of its positive divisors excluding itself. Print true if num is perfect, else false.

problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.desc: Given n, calculate F(n) where F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, and F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2).

problems.title: Detect Capital
problems.desc: Given a word S, return true if the usage of capitals in it is right (all uppercase, all lowercase, or only first letter capitalized), else false.

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, return the length of the diameter (longest path between any two nodes in number of edges).

problems.title: Maximum Average Subarray I
problems.desc: Read N and k on line 1, followed by N integers on line 2. Find a contiguous subarray of length k that has the maximum average value, and print it with up to 5 decimal places.

problems.title: Set Mismatch
problems.desc: Given N and an array representing numbers from 1 to N with one number duplicated and one missing, output the duplicated number followed by the missing number separated by space.

problems.title: Binary Number with Alternating Bits
problems.desc: Given a positive integer n, check whether two adjacent bits in its binary representation always have different values. Print true or false.

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.desc: Read N and target on line 1, followed by N sorted distinct integers. Return the 0-based index of target, or -1 if it does not exist.

problems.title: Lemonade Change
problems.desc: Each lemonade costs $5. Customers pay with $5, $10, or $20 bills. Given N and the sequence of bills, print true if you can provide every customer with correct change, else false.

problems.title: Binary Gap
problems.desc: Given a positive integer n, find and return the longest distance between any two adjacent 1's in the binary representation of n. If no two 1's exist, print 0.

problems.title: Middle of the Linked List
problems.desc: Given N and a linked list of N numbers, output the list starting from the middle node to the end. (If two middle nodes, pick the second).

problems.title: Remove Outermost Parentheses
problems.desc: Given a valid parentheses string S, split it into primitive valid strings, remove the outermost parentheses of each primitive string, and output the result.

problems.title: Height Checker
problems.desc: Students are asked to stand in non-decreasing order of heights. Return the number of indices where the actual heights do not match the expected sorted order.

problems.title: Minimum Time Visiting All Points
problems.desc: Given N 2D points, return the minimum time in seconds to visit all points in order (moving 1 unit horizontally, vertically, or diagonally takes 1 second).

problems.title: Convert Binary Number in a Linked List to Integer
problems.desc: Given N and the binary digits (0 or 1) of a linked list, return the decimal value of the number in the linked list.

problems.title: Check if Array Is Sorted and Rotated
problems.desc: Given N and an integer array, return true if the array was originally sorted in non-decreasing order, then rotated some number of positions (including zero).

problems.title: Concatenation of Array
problems.desc: Given N and an array nums of length N, output an array ans of length 2N where ans is nums concatenated with itself.

problems.title: Check if All Characters Have Equal Number of Occurrences
problems.desc: Given a string s, return true if all characters that appear in s have the same number of occurrences, else false.

problems.title: Score of a String
problems.desc: The score of a string is the sum of the absolute difference between the ASCII values of adjacent characters. Print the score of string s.

problems.title: Transform Array by Parity
problems.desc: Given N and an array, replace each even number with 0 and each odd number with 1, then sort the array in non-decreasing order and print it.

problems.title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Sum Divisible by K
problems.desc: Given N and K, followed by N integers, you can subtract 1 from any element. Output the minimum number of operations to make the sum divisible by K.

problems.title: Add Two Numbers
problems.desc: You are given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers stored in reverse order. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list in reverse order.

problems.title: Reverse Integer
problems.desc: Given a signed 32-bit integer x, return x with its digits reversed. If reversing x causes the value to go outside the 32-bit signed range [-2^31, 2^31 - 1], return 0.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.desc: Given N and an integer array height of length N, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water. Output the max area.

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.desc: Given N and k on line 1, followed by a linked list of N numbers on line 2, remove the k-th node from the end of the list and print the remaining list.

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.desc: Given N and target on line 1, followed by a rotated sorted array of distinct integers, return the 0-based index of target, or -1 if not in the array.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.desc: Given N and an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

problems.title: Sort Colors
problems.desc: Given N and an array nums with N objects colored red (0), white (1), or blue (2), sort them in-place so that objects of the same color are adjacent.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List II
problems.desc: Read N, left, right on line 1, then N numbers on line 2. Reverse the nodes of the list from position left to position right (1-indexed), and print the list.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, print true if it is a valid binary search tree (BST), and false otherwise.

problems.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
problems.desc: Given a binary tree, return the zigzag level order traversal (alternating left-to-right and right-to-left) of its nodes' values, printing each level on a new line.

problems.title: Path Sum II
problems.desc: Given targetSum and a binary tree, output all root-to-leaf paths where sum equals targetSum. Output each path on a new line.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle II
problems.desc: Given a linked list with pos (where tail points to), return the 0-based node index where the cycle begins. If no cycle, output -1.

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.desc: Given N and a linked list L0 -> L1 -> ... -> Ln, reorder it to L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> Ln-1 -> L2 -> Ln-2... and print the resulting sequence.

problems.title: Find Peak Element
problems.desc: A peak element is an element that is strictly greater than its neighbors. Given N and nums, find any peak element and print its 0-based index.

problems.title: Two Sum II – Input Array Is Sorted
problems.desc: Given N and target, followed by a 1-indexed sorted array of N integers, find the two numbers such that they add up to target. Output the 1-based indices.

problems.title: Rotate Array
problems.desc: Given N and k on line 1, followed by N integers on line 2, rotate the array to the right by k steps. Print the rotated array.

problems.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
problems.desc: Given the level-order representation of a binary tree, imagine yourself standing on the right side of it; return the values of the nodes you can see ordered from top to bottom.

problems.title: Count Complete Tree Nodes
problems.desc: Given the root of a complete binary tree in level-order, return the total number of nodes in the tree in less than O(n) time.

problems.title: Delete Node in a Linked List
problems.desc: Read N and val on line 1, followed by N distinct integers on line 2. Delete the node with value val from the linked list and print the resulting sequence.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.desc: Given N and k on line 1, followed by an integer array of size N on line 2, return the k most frequent elements in descending order of frequency.

problems.title: Amount of Time for Binary Tree to Be Infected
problems.desc: Read start node on line 1, followed by level-order tree on line 2. At minute 0, the node start is infected. Each minute infection spreads to adjacent nodes. Output minutes needed to infect entire tree.

problems.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
problems.desc: Given two sorted arrays nums1 of size m and nums2 of size n, return the median of the two sorted arrays with up to 5 decimal places.
